screen.another-hud-mod.editor.instructio: Drag to move. Shift-click a HUD for quick settings.
screen.another-hud-mod.editor.title: HUD Layout Editor
screen.another-hud-mod.settings.armor.ce: Centers equipped armor slots when empty slots are hidden.
screen.another-hud-mod.settings.armor.or: Arranges armor slots horizontally or vertically.
screen.another-hud-mod.settings.armor.sc: Changes the size of the entire Armor HUD.
screen.another-hud-mod.settings.armor.sh: Shows slots even when no armor is equipped.
screen.another-hud-mod.settings.armor.sl: Selects the background style used for armor slots.
screen.another-hud-mod.settings.armor.sp: Controls the space between armor slots.
